The '''Mizra system''' was located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="TEA" /> and shared its name with the [[Mizra Syndrome]], which could be [[Death/Legends|deadly]] to [[Human/Legends|Humans]],<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=class|Smuggler|A Brother's Request|Voss}}</ref> as well as the [[1466 BBY]] [[Battle of Mizra]] of the [[New Sith Wars]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mizra [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-8.<ref name="TEA" />
